title: Stack the Moon
description: Build a moonlit observatory above the clouds, one perfectly timed stone at a time. Chain perfect landings to restore your tower and climb into the stars.
controls: Click, tap or Space to stack. P / Escape to pause. R to restart. Sound starts after your first input.

zh-CN.title: 叠叠月
zh-CN.description: 在云上一块一块叠起月光天文台，时机准就完美落位。连续完美落位能修复塔身，一路叠进星空。
zh-CN.controls: 点击、轻触或空格放下石块 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开 · 第一次操作后开启声音
